# Test font

`UndocTestSans-Regular.ttf` is a modified version of Noto Sans KR (weight 400 instance), cut
down to the characters the slide rasterizer's tests draw and renamed "Undoc Test Sans", as the
SIL Open Font License requires of a modified version. Its license is in `OFL.txt`.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanskr
